scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @terminal49/sdk && npm run build --workspace @terminal49/mcp && npm run build --workspace @terminal49/cli
scripts.check: vp check && npm run build --workspace @terminal49/sdk && npm run type-check:api && vp run -r type-check
scripts.lint:api: vp lint api && vp fmt --check api
scripts.test: npm run test:security && npm run test:agent-trust && npm run test:risk-policy && vp run -r test
